en: Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor acquired by clinging and not subject to clinging … (Abbreviated.
Under the root condition there are twenty-nine; under the object condition, twenty-four … pe … under the result condition, nine … pe … under the non-disappearance condition, twenty-nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor not acquired by clinging and subject to clinging … (Abbreviated.)

With respect to the root condition, seventeen; ... pe ... with respect to the repetition condition, nine; ... pe ... with respect to the result condition, nine; ... pe ... with respect to the non-disappearance condition, seventeen.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome, nor clung-to, nor subject to clinging ... (Abbreviated). With respect to the root condition, twenty-nine; with respect to the object condition, twenty-four;
... pe ... with respect to the result condition, nine; ... pe ... with respect to the non-disappearance condition, twenty-nine.
